name: METR-LA
description: A traffic forecasting benchmark containing traffic speed measurements from 207 loop detectors on Los Angeles County highways, collected over four months in 2012.
citation: Li, Y., Yu, R., Shahabi, C., & Liu, Y. (2018). Diffusion Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network: Data-Driven Traffic Forecasting. International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR). https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.01926
